name: UK Black Pride
what: Celebration and organisation for LGBTQ+ people of African, Caribbean, Asian and Latin American descent.
where: London — Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park (flagship event, paused for 2026)
evidence: Flagship annual festival paused for 2026 in favour of a 2027 return, but org confirmed continuing 2026 community-led events/activations (with UAL, Bleecker, DIVA) in a dated announcement 7 May 2026 (diva-magazine.com; ukblackpride.org.uk/news/uk-black-pride-announces-strategic-reset-ahead-of-landmark-return-in-2027). Directory's 2026-event claim is superseded — using the live site/press.

name: Glitter Cymru
what: Wales' largest grassroots charity for LGBTQ+ global majority people, running Pride and regular meetups.
regular: Weekly Saturday online drop-in (2-3pm); monthly meetups (per directory, not contradicted by live evidence)
evidence: Glitter Pride 2026 — Global Solidarity ran Sun 23 Aug 2026 at Temple of Peace, Cardiff (Eventbrite/EventsList); documentary screening 'Documentary Screening - 10 Years of Glitter Cymru' 13 Aug 2026 and a comedy night 7 Aug 2026 (scenemag.co.uk, herald.wales). Own site (glittercymru.org.uk) returned 403 to direct fetch; evidence drawn from press/ticketing coverage instead. Dedupes 'Glitter Pride (Wales)' (organised by Glitter Cymru) from the directory into this one entry.

name: Melanin Vybz (London LGBTQ+ Community Centre)
what: Monthly group for Black and POC LGBTQ+ people over 50, hosted at London's LGBTQ+ community centre.
evidence: Melanin Vybz (LGBTQ+ BPOC 50+ Meetup) session was scheduled for Thu 13 Aug 2026 — cancelled that day only due to a heatwave closure notice on londonlgbtqcentre.org/whats-on, which confirms the programme is currently running as part of the Centre's live August 2026 calendar (42 events listed).

name: Rainbow Noir Manchester
what: Social, peer support and community action group in Manchester for LGBTQI people of colour.
where: Manchester — The Proud Place, 49-51 Sidney Street
evidence: rainbownoirmcr.com currently lists 'Save the dates for our 2026 QTIPOC meet ups' (Thursdays at The Proud Place, first date 8 Jan 2026), i.e. a live, current programme listing; also an Instagram post from Manchester Pride weekend 2026 ('Happy Manchester Pride — Rainbow Noir, George House', instagram.com/p/DNsUrDe0OrO/). Directory's rainbownoir.org.uk domain no longer resolves (DNS failure) — current domain is rainbownoirmcr.com.

name: UNMUTED
what: Meetups, book club and advocacy network for LGBTQI people of colour in Birmingham and the West Midlands.
evidence: unmutedbrum.com blocked direct fetch (403) and failed via Firecrawl (all engines); Impact Hub Birmingham event page unreachable (DNS); Waterstones QTIPOC Book Club event pages (Freshwater, The Colour Purple, Proud) found via search but blocked (403) so no date confirmed; web search surfaced only undated listings. No dated 2026 activity confirmed either way.

name: Colours Youth Network
what: Support network for QTIPOC young people aged 16-25 UK-wide, plus a quarterly space for youth workers.
evidence: coloursyouthnetwork.com blocked direct fetch (403); Eventbrite organiser page (eventbrite.co.uk/o/colours-youth-network-28774520493) shows 'Nothing planned right now' with no past events surfaced; web search found only historical/generic festival mentions, no dated 2026 activity. No dated activity confirmed either way.

name: LGBT Youth Scotland
what: National charity for LGBTQ+ young people aged 13-25 in Scotland, incl. rural programming and residentials.
evidence: Edinburgh Pride Youth Hub confirmed for Sat 20 Jun 2026 at Edinburgh Futures Institute (lgbtyouth.org.uk/edinburgh-pride-youth-space); a new Fruitmarket Gallery art project for 16-24s starts Oct 2026. Not QTIPOC/Black-specific — general LGBTQ+ youth charity — so does not meet the publish threshold.

name: Inclusive Mosque Initiative (IMI)
what: Intersectional-feminist Islam community holding QTIPOC-inclusive worship and events, mostly in London.
evidence: inclusivemosque.org shows an Operations Manager role with apply-by deadline 18 May 2026 plus open Trustee/Treasurer recruitment — dated but organisational, not programme activity. IMI's own Eventbrite organiser page (eventbrite.co.uk/o/inclusive-mosque-initiative-9838200684) says 'Nothing planned right now'. No dated worship/event activity confirmed.

name: Imaan
what: UK's oldest charity for LGBTQI+ Muslims — support groups, Ramadan/Eid/Pride events and schools outreach.
evidence: imaanlondon.wordpress.com's News & Events section shows nothing newer than a 25 Jun 2023 Pride-march post; Imaan's Eventbrite organiser page (eventbrite.co.uk/o/imaan-lgbtqi-muslim-support-64611384743) says 'Nothing planned right now'. Web search confirms the charity still describes itself as running regular Positive East socials and Ramadan/Eid events, but no dated 2026 instance was found. No dated activity confirmed either way.

name: Hidayah LGBT+
what: Charity supporting LGBTQI+ Muslims across the UK and US with events, welfare and education.
evidence: Queer Muslim Iftar 2026 listed for Sat 28 Feb 2026 in London (outsavvy.com/event/32094/queer-muslim-iftar-2026-london; consortium.lgbt/event/hidayah-london-iftar); hidayahlgbt.com carries a live 'past events' organiser listing.

name: Open Table Network
what: Network of LGBTQIA+ affirming Christian communities across England and Wales.
evidence: opentable.lgbt lists 'OUT @ the Long Table' at Greenbelt Festival dated 30 Aug 2026, a new community-testimony film released 19 Aug 2026, updated impact research published 30 Jul 2026, and an emergency crowdfunding appeal launched 6 Jul 2026 after grant funding ended; site states 37 communities currently supported. Not race-specific, so does not meet the publish threshold.

name: House of Rainbow
what: Faith community and global network centring Black, African and Caribbean LGBTIQ+ people of faith.
evidence: 'From Hurt to Hope, Faith Without Fear' (UK Black Pride Fellowship) held Sun 16 Aug 2026 (eventbrite.co.uk/e/from-hurt-to-hope-faith-without-fear-tickets-1994316962721); 20th Anniversary Celebration scheduled Sun 6 Sep 2026 at Union Chapel (eventbrite.co.uk/e/house-of-rainbow-20th-anniversary-celebration-tickets-1993025218078).

name: OneBodyOneFaith
what: Grassroots charity advocating for LGBT+ Christians and change within the church, for people of faith.
evidence: Trustee Strategy Day held Sat 24 Jan 2026 produced a renewed 2026 vision statement (onebodyonefaith.org.uk/news/); org marking its 50th anniversary through 2026 and currently recruiting a Co-Chair and up to four new Trustees. Not race-specific, so does not meet the publish threshold.

name: Pxssy Palace
what: Arts and club-night platform for Black, Indigenous and POC women, queer, trans and non-binary people.
evidence: 'Fever x Shoga Shoga' listed as an Exclusively Black Event, Fri 28-Sat 29 Aug 2026, 26 Denmark Street, London (skiddle.com/artists/pxssy-palace-123571367). Pxssypalace.com's own 'upcoming events' section had no dates when fetched directly.

name: BBZ London
what: Curatorial and club-night collective for queer, trans and non-binary people of colour.
evidence: Web search surfaced only historical press (Dazed, Crack, Standard Hotels) and a vague reference to a 'Black Pride NL' Instagram takeover with no date; no BBZ listing found on RA or elsewhere with a 2026 date. No dated activity confirmed either way.

name: House of Noir
what: Voguing/ballroom house and fashion platform for QTIPOC performers in Manchester.
evidence: Factory International's 'House of Noir Presents... Kiki in Our House' page returned a 2020 date range, and other results (Manchester Pride, MIF Live tie-ins) were undated/historical press. No dated 2026 activity confirmed.

name: RebeccaNeverBecky (RNB)
what: Manchester events collective spotlighting LGBT+, QTIBPOC and BAME DJs, artists and creatives.
evidence: A Contact Manchester event page possibly linking RNB to 'Queer Hope and Joy!' returned 404; other results were founder profile/press pieces with no dated 2026 event. No dated activity confirmed either way.

name: The Cocoa Butter Club
what: Black and LGBTQIA+-owned cabaret production company ('Decolonise & Moisturise') touring Manchester and London.
evidence: A 'Block Party featuring Cocoa Butter Club' listing appears in Visit Manchester travel packages for Jan-Mar 2026, but the event page itself gave no confirmable date on fetch; the club's own /cabaret page lists venues (Soho House, HOME Manchester, Southbank Centre) but no dated schedule. No dated activity confirmed with certainty.

name: Rat Party
what: Queer club night in Leeds led by and for QTIPOC, sex worker and trans+/gender-variant communities.
evidence: RA promoter page (ra.co/promoters/104027) lists a long run of past nights at Eiger Studios, Sable Studio and Distillery N17, but returned 403 on direct fetch so no most-recent date could be confirmed, and search results skewed to 2022-2023 events. No dated 2026 activity confirmed.

name: Scotch Bonnet
what: Collaborative creative and social space for QTIPOC and allies in Glasgow.
evidence: Facebook page (facebook.com/sctchbnnt) confirmed to exist (857+ likes, per directory) but no dated 2026 post or event surfaced via search. No dated activity confirmed either way.

name: Black Trans Alliance C.I.C
what: Black queer and trans-led movement supporting and amplifying Black trans and non-binary people.
evidence: News post 'EHRC Updates Equality Act Code of Practice: What It Means for Black Trans and Non-Binary Communities in the UK' on blacktransalliance.org responds to the Code being laid before Parliament 21 May 2026 (confirmed via Hansard/Make UK/DLA Piper coverage) — dated org commentary within the window, alongside live Peer-to-Peer Support and Community Ally Program pages.

name: Trans Aid Cymru
what: Mutual aid providing grants and support for transgender, non-binary and intersex people across Wales.
evidence: OpenCollective page (opencollective.com/transaidcymru) shows a completed financial contribution dated 28 Aug 2026, confirming the fund is currently live and receiving/processing donations. Not race-specific, so does not meet the publish threshold.

name: Rainbow Migration
what: Legal, practical and emotional support for LGBTQI+ people seeking asylum or facing immigration issues.
evidence: Statement on Home Secretary's asylum changes dated 2 Mar 2026 (rainbowmigration.org.uk/news/asylum-changes-announcement-2-march-2026); Pride Month 2026 'messages of support' campaign drew 500+ messages in a month. Not race-specific, so does not meet the publish threshold.

name: Micro Rainbow
what: Safe housing and community programming for LGBTQI people seeking asylum, refugees and migrants.
evidence: 'In Conversation with: Micro Rainbow' published Jun 2026 on thenewfeminist.co.uk covers its ~30 current safe houses and a new film, 'Who's There?'; org has scaled back face-to-face events for staff/service-user safety amid rising hostility but housing/support operations continue. Not race-specific, so does not meet the publish threshold.

name: African Rainbow Family (ARF)
what: Advocacy and support for LGBTIQ+ people of African heritage, including asylum seekers and refugees.
evidence: Ran a community stall at Sparkle Weekend, Sackville Gardens, Manchester, Sat 27 Jun 2026 ('Trans Solidarity & Celebration at Sparkle Weekend 2026', africanrainbowfamily.org/2026/06/29/...), supporting trans/non-binary people of African heritage and educating on asylum-system intersections.
